name: Englewood
seo_title: Englewood Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 6 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Englewood, CO: the Holiday Express train at Belleview Park, Sunday train rides, the Holiday Market and Tree Lighting, and Santa visits.
lede: Englewood does Christmas around a little train, with the city's Holiday Express at Belleview Park and a Civic Center tree lighting that follows a morning holiday market.
celebrates: Englewood's season centers on two city sites. At Belleview Park, the city turns Englewood Farm & Train into the Holiday Express, with lights, s'mores, crafts, unlimited train rides and visits from Santa on four December evenings, plus two Sunday evenings for train rides only. On Saturday, December 5 the Civic Center hosts the Holiday Market in the morning and the Holiday Tree Lighting from 3 to 6 pm, with live performances, Santa, a build your own s'more station and food trucks. Neighbors run their own events too, from pictures with Santa at Zara Rhythmic Gymnastics to a Salvation Army concert in Cherry Hills Village.
lastyear: The City of Englewood has run the Holiday Express at Belleview Park in earlier seasons, and its event page keeps a photo gallery of past evenings with the lit park and the train. The city's tree lighting page calls the Civic Center event a cherished tradition that brings the community together each December. We did not find a published 2025 attendance or schedule recap on the city's pages, so check the city's events page for current updates.
facts: Englewood describes itself as a proudly independent, full service community with the third highest concentration of millennials in Colorado. The city's history chronology notes that the Cherrelyn Horsecar, a horse drawn streetcar, stopped running on a regular basis in 1908. The city also runs a Holiday Decorating Contest, which asks that displays be available for viewing from December 1 through January 6 and be lighted from 6 to 10 pm each evening.
trains: Englewood has its own train: the Englewood Train at Englewood Farm & Train in Belleview Park carries families around the holiday lights, and it has an accessible ramp with secure straps for wheelchairs. During the Holiday Express, trains load on a rolling basis and depart about every 15 minutes. RTD also lists an Englewood Station among its rail stations. For bigger rail history, see the Forney Museum in Denver and the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden.

faq: What is the Englewood Holiday Express?

It is the City of Englewood's holiday event at Belleview Park, on the grounds of Englewood Farm & Train. The city lists lights, s'mores, crafts, unlimited train rides and visits from Santa, with hot cocoa and warm drinks for purchase. Tickets are sold through the city's recreation ticket site, and buyers need a city recreation account.

The city says the Englewood Train has an accessible ramp with secure straps for guests in wheelchairs. The entrance is through the parking lot, down a paved asphalt ramp and over two railroad ties, and the Santa, cocoa and train areas are asphalt, while crafts and s'mores are on grass.
Where can kids see the Englewood tree lighting?

The City of Englewood holds its Holiday Tree Lighting at the Englewood Civic Center, 1000 Englewood Parkway, from 3 to 6 pm. The city lists live performances, visits with Santa, a build your own s'more station and food trucks. A Holiday Market with local vendors comes earlier in the day.
Are there free Christmas events in Englewood?

Some are free, such as pictures with Santa at Zara Rhythmic Gymnastics and a Salvation Army Christmas concert in Cherry Hills Village, which fold into this page. The Holiday Express is a paid ticket, so check each listing on this page for current prices and dates, since hosts can change plans.
Can we ride a train near Englewood without the Holiday Express?

Yes. The city also lists Sunday Train Rides on two December Sundays, when the Englewood Train circles Belleview Park under the lights. The Forney Museum of Transportation in Denver and the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden are bigger rail stops, and each has its own page on our site.

The magic runs from December 4 (Englewood Holiday Express at Belleview Park) through December 20 (Grand Polar Express Movie Night with Santa at The Barn), with Sunday Train Rides (December 6 and 13), the Holiday Market and Tree Lighting (December 5) and pictures with Santa at Zara Rhythmic Gymnastics (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
